footer.safeMessage: KidZone is a safe place made just for kids. No sign-ups, no ads, just pure fun!

hero.heading: Welcome to KidZone! 🎉
hero.body: This is MY favourite place to play! There are games, puzzles, colouring, and memory challenges waiting for you. Pick something and let's have fun! 🌈

activity-cards.title: Mini-Games
activity-cards.description: Play awesome little games like catching stars and popping bubbles! Can you beat your high score?

activity-cards.title: Puzzles
activity-cards.description: Drag the pieces and build cool pictures! Start easy or try a tricky one!

activity-cards.title: Coloring
activity-cards.description: Grab your favourite colours and paint amazing cartoon pictures! Save your art when you're done!

activity-cards.title: Memory Challenge
activity-cards.description: Flip the cards and find the matching pairs! How fast can you find them all?

character-mascot.heading: Meet Zappy! ⚡
character-mascot.body: Zappy is my best cartoon buddy! He lives here at KidZone and loves cheering you on. When you finish an activity, Zappy does a happy dance just for you! 🕺

progress-tracker.text: Colour a whole picture — earn 2 stars!
Win the Memory Challenge — earn 2 stars!
Collect 6 stars — unlock a surprise from Zappy!

progress-tracker-body: Every time you finish an activity, you earn a shiny star! Collect stars to fill up your trophy. How many can YOU get today? 🏆

sound-toggle.heading: Music On or Off? 🎵
sound-toggle.body: I love the fun music here! Press the button to turn the sounds and music on or off — whatever feels best for you! 🔊

mini-games-header.heading: 🎮 Mini-Games!
mini-games-header.body: Pick a game and let's play! You can try lots of different games right here. Every time you finish one, you get a star! ⭐

game-selector.title: Frog Jump
game-selector.description: Help Freddy the Frog hop over logs without falling in the water!

game-selector.title: Star Catcher
game-selector.description: Move your basket left and right to catch falling stars before they disappear!

game-selector.title: Balloon Pop
game-selector.description: Tap the balloons as fast as you can before they float away!

game-selector.title: Turtle Race
game-selector.description: Tap super fast to make your turtle zoom to the finish line first!

game-selector.title: Fruit Sort
game-selector.description: Drag each fruit into the right basket — watch out for the sneaky veggies!

game-selector.title: Space Dodge
game-selector.description: Steer your rocket ship and dodge the asteroids flying at you!

game-canvas.label: Easy
game-canvas.description: Great for beginners, nice and slow 🐢

game-canvas.label: Medium
game-canvas.description: A little faster, can you keep up? 🐇

game-canvas.label: Hard
game-canvas.description: Super speedy, only for brave players! 🦁

game-canvas-body: Your game shows up in this big space! Use your fingers or mouse to play. Press the big START button when you're ready.

score-display.label: Score
score-display.description: Every good move adds points, keep going!

score-display.label: Lives
score-display.description: You get 3 hearts, don't lose them all!

score-display.label: Level
score-display.description: Finish a level to unlock the next one!

score-display-body: Check your score, lives, and level right here while you play. Try to beat your best score!

completion-celebration-mini-games.text: 1 Star — great start, you finished the game!
2 Stars — awesome, you did really well!
3 Stars — PERFECT! You're a KidZone champion!

completion-body: WOW, amazing job! You finished the game! Confetti is flying everywhere just for you! Collect your stars and try another game!

puzzles-header.heading: 🧩 Puzzle Time!
puzzles-header.body: Drag the pieces and build the picture! Can you finish it? Let's find out! 🌟

puzzle-selector.title: Roaring Lion
puzzle-selector.description: A big friendly lion in the sunny jungle!

puzzle-selector.title: Rocket in Space
puzzle-selector.description: Zoom past the stars and planets!

puzzle-selector.title: Magic Castle
puzzle-selector.description: A sparkly castle with a rainbow bridge!

puzzle-selector.title: Unicorn Meadow
puzzle-selector.description: A magical unicorn in a field of flowers!

puzzle-selector.title: Around the World
puzzle-selector.description: Landmarks from all over the globe!

puzzle-canvas.text: Drag a piece from the tray on the right
Drop it where you think it goes on the big board
Pieces snap into place when they're in the right spot!
Stuck? Tap the 🔍 Hint button for a little peek at the full picture
Want to start over? Hit the 🔄 Shuffle button anytime

puzzle-canvas-body: Drag each piece to the right spot. When two pieces fit together you'll hear a fun click! Keep going — you're doing amazing! 💪

progress-bar.text: 1 Star — You placed your first piece! Great start!
2 Stars — Halfway there! You're on fire! 🔥
3 Stars — Puzzle complete! You're a puzzle champion! 🏆

progress-bar-body: Watch your progress bar fill up as you place more pieces! Every piece you get right earns you a star. Keep going — the finish line is close!

completion-celebration-puzzles.text: 🎨 Try the Coloring page next and colour your favourite picture!
🧩 Pick another puzzle and beat your best time!

coloring-header.heading: 🎨 Color Time!
coloring-header.body: Pick your colours and make something amazing! You can draw, colour, and create anything you want. There are no rules — just have fun! 🌈

color-palette.name: White
color-palette.description: Use it to lighten things up!

canvas-area.heading: Your Drawing Space! ✏️
canvas-area.body: This is YOUR canvas! Draw, scribble, colour in shapes, or make up your own picture. Tap or drag your finger to start! Don't worry about mistakes — you can always erase! 😊

tool-options.label: Tiny Brush
tool-options.description: Great for small details and thin lines

tool-options.label: Medium Brush
tool-options.description: Just right for colouring most things

tool-options.label: Big Brush
tool-options.description: Fill in large spaces super fast!

tool-options.label: Eraser
tool-options.description: Oops! Rub out any part you don't like

tool-options.label: Clear All
tool-options.description: Start your picture all over again from scratch

tool-options-body: Change your brush, use the eraser, or start fresh! Pick the tool that feels right for you.

save-share.label: Save My Drawing
save-share.description: Download your art as a picture to keep forever!

save-share.label: Print It Out
save-share.description: Print your drawing and put it on the fridge!

save-share-body: Finished your masterpiece? Save it so you can look at it later! You did an amazing job — you're a real artist! 🎉

memory-header.heading: Memory Challenge! 🧠✨
memory-header.body: Can you find all the matching pairs? Flip the cards and remember where each cartoon friend is hiding! The faster you go, the more stars you win! ⭐

difficulty-selector.label: Easy 🌟
difficulty-selector.description: 8 cards, 4 pairs. Great for beginners! Find Sunny the Lion and friends!

difficulty-selector.label: Medium 🌟🌟
difficulty-selector.description: 16 cards, 8 pairs. A bit trickier! More cartoon pals to remember!

difficulty-selector.label: Hard 🌟🌟🌟
difficulty-selector.description: 24 cards, 12 pairs. Only memory champions can beat this one!

difficulty-selector-heading: Pick How Hard You Want It! 💪
difficulty-selector-body: Start easy if you're new, or go super hard if you're a memory master! You can always try again!

game-board.name: Sunny the Lion
game-board.description: A big fluffy lion with a golden mane and a huge smile!

game-board.name: Ziggy the Zebra
game-board.description: A speedy zebra with cool black-and-white stripes!

game-board.name: Pip the Penguin
game-board.description: A tiny penguin who loves to dance and slide on ice!

game-board.name: Rosie the Rabbit
game-board.description: A pink bunny with floppy ears and a carrot in her hand!

game-board.name: Cosmo the Alien
game-board.description: A little green alien with three eyes and a big wave!

game-board.name: Blaze the Dragon
game-board.description: A friendly purple dragon who breathes rainbow fire!

game-board.name: Finn the Fish
game-board.description: A sparkly blue fish who blows shiny bubbles!

game-board.name: Mochi the Panda
game-board.description: A round, sleepy panda munching on bamboo!

game-board.name: Bolt the Robot
game-board.description: A silver robot with blinking lights and a big heart!

game-board.name: Luna the Owl
game-board.description: A wise little owl wearing tiny star-shaped glasses!

game-board.name: Coco the Monkey
game-board.description: A cheeky monkey swinging from a rainbow vine!

game-board.name: Sparky the Star
game-board.description: A glowing yellow star with a happy winking face!

game-board-body: Tap a card to flip it over and see which cartoon friend is hiding! Find two that match to keep them! Find all the pairs to win! 🎉

score-timer.label: Moves
score-timer.description: Every time you flip two cards, that's one move. Try to keep it low!

score-timer.label: Time ⏱️
score-timer.description: The clock starts when you flip your first card. How fast can you go?

score-timer.label: Stars ⭐
score-timer.description: Finish with fewer moves to earn 1, 2, or 3 big gold stars!

score-timer.label: Best Score 🥇
score-timer.description: Your best moves and time are saved so you can try to beat yourself!

score-timer-body: Watch your moves and your time! Try to use fewer moves and finish faster to get more stars! You've got this! 💫

completion-celebration-memory.text: ⭐ 1 Star — Amazing try! You finished the game, and that's super cool!
⭐⭐ 2 Stars — Wow, great memory! You're really getting good at this!
⭐⭐⭐ 3 Stars — PERFECT! You are a true Memory Champion! 🏆
Play Again 🔄 — try to beat your best score!
Try a Harder Level 💪 — ready for more cards and more cartoon friends?
Go to Mini-Games 🎮 — check out even more fun games on KidZone!

completion-celebration-memory-body: WOW! You matched all the cartoon friends! You are a memory superstar! Collect your stars and try again to get an even better score!

hero.title: Mini-Games Zone 🎮
hero.subtitle: Pick a game, score 10 points, and win a celebration! How fast can you do it?

gameNames.name: Balloon Pop
gameNames.desc: Tap the balloons before they float away! Every pop earns a point.

gameNames.name: Number Catch
gameNames.desc: Catch only the number shown at the top. Wrong numbers cost a life!

gameNames.name: Color Match
gameNames.desc: Tap the button that matches the color of the big circle. Be quick!

gameNames.name: Whack-a-Mole
gameNames.desc: Bop the mole when it pops up! Miss it and you lose a life.

colorMatch.instruction: Tap the button that matches this color!

celebration.title: You Won!
celebration.subtitle: Amazing job! You scored all 10 points!

howToWin.title: How to Win
howToWin.body: Score {count} points in any game to unlock the celebration! You get 3 lives per round. Level up every 5 points for extra challenge.

hero.title: Memory Challenge
hero.subtitle: Flip the cards and find all the matching pairs. How fast can you finish?

tips.text: Watch carefully when cards flip over. Try to remember where each animal lives!
Start from one corner and work your way across. A pattern helps your brain remember.
Take your time on Easy mode first. Speed comes after you know the trick!
Fewer moves means more stars. Think before you flip to get a perfect score!

modal.title: You Did It!
modal.subtitle: Amazing memory! You matched all the pairs!

tips.heading: Tips for Super Players
tips.sub: Follow these tips to become a KidZone champion!

items.text: Play every day to collect more stars and unlock cool surprises!
Memory Challenge gets easier the more you practice. Keep going!
There are no wrong colors in the coloring pages. Be as wild as you like!
Try the Hard difficulty in Mini-Games for extra bragging rights!
Play with a friend and take turns. Two brains are better than one!
Having fun is the most important rule. Enjoy every second!
